facts.fact: The Legal & Human Rights Centre alleges in a case filed at the East African Court of Justice on 8 December 2025 that the Tanzanian government carried out a total nationwide internet shutdown from 29 October to 4 November 2025, cutting mobile data, websites and online platforms; this is the applicant's allegation, no judgment is recorded.
facts.system: Nationwide internet shutdown, 29 October to 4 November 2025

note: No judgment or verdict is given, so nothing for connection:barred.
